units.source_text: 他像被弹回去似的，拼命往来的路上跑回去。

en.t: As if he had been flung back, he ran desperately back along the road he had come.

units.source_text: 几乎都是反射的判断，尽可能横穿过连着海角的沙丘。

en.t: It was almost entirely a reflexive decision: he cut across the dunes leading to the cape as much as he could.

units.source_text: 村落里的人们，大叫着追过来了。

en.t: The people from the village came chasing after him, shouting loudly.

units.source_text: 大概是太紧急了，膝盖像被抽掉了关节似的，跑起来嘎吱嘎吱地响。

en.t: Perhaps because the situation was so urgent, his knees felt as if their joints had been pulled out, and they creaked with every step he ran.

units.source_text: 他不时回头张望，出人意料的是，他居然一直能和追兵保持一段宽宽的距离。

en.t: He kept glancing back from time to time, and to his surprise, he was somehow able to maintain a wide distance from his pursuers.
